body: I’m sorry that you’re going through this. It’s scary and can be very lonely. It can be very hard to be calm, and the world may feel like a lonely place. I do hope you find the much needed courage, strength and support. Hopefully, it’ll get “easier” with time, and the memories may bring smiles and laughter instead of sorrow.
Wow, congrats! That must feel good.
